source.title: A Student of the Arcane
source.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
source.objective: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
